disk.refuse_if_free_below: 1.5 x expected peak (remaining growth on a resumed grid)

config.never_two_copies: scheduler lock + a process-table scan for the run name before every start
config.one_gate: data/v2/gates.json g7.pass is true and both g7 report hashes match the files
config.order: PPO first, then DDQN (SPEC 12.2 table order). PPO: seed ascending, plain then D4 within a seed (plain s0, D4 s0, plain s1, ...). DDQN: seed ascending. The queue refills a freed slot with the next job in this order.
config.per_job_check: breachlens.manifest.check_manifest_file on the run's manifest.json at the end of every job; failure = job marked manifest_failed

retention.plus: final model, identity, manifest, val_eval.csv, val_layouts.jsonl, logs
